title: Forward Deployed Computational Biologist
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Please submit your CV in English Salary range: $128,000 - $150,000 Ideal start date: January or February 2027 About the role: We are seeking a Forward Deployed Computational Biologist to operate at the intersection of AI, software systems, and biology. In this role, you will work directly with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions for complex scientific problems as part of Owkin’s agentic platform, K Pro, to fully meet specific customer needs. This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will spend time at the customer’s premises, turning ambiguous scientific challenges—such as discovering novel drug targets or disease subtypes—into reliable and scalable agentic solutions. You will be responsible for both the scientific rigor of the analytical workflows and the technical robustness of their implementation and deployment, bridging the gap between science and real-world application. In particular, you will: Deploy & Custom-build : Tailor Owkin’s agentic AI platform, K Pro, to specific client needs by implementing new analytical workflows, and integrate our platform into the clients’ existing workflows. Solve Scientific Problems : Translate complex biological and operational questions into concrete computational workflows, utilizing deep clinical and multi-omics data (genomics, transcriptomics, etc.) and computational biology methodologies. Rapid Prototyping : Iterate quickly with users to validate solutions, balancing speed and quality to ensure effective, measurable impact. Collaboration : Work alongside Customer Success Managers, R&D data scientists, biologists, and software engineers to ensure the delivery of high-quality scientific insights. Knowledge Transfer : Communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders—from clinicians and biologists to technical engineering teams—to ensure alignment and adoption. Participation in a team-wide on-call rotation is required. This role requires frequent international travel to support our global operations and client needs. Anticipated destinations include the Owkin Paris office as well as various client premises across the UK, US, France, Germany, and Switzerland. To facilitate this travel schedule, the successful candidate must be based in close proximity to a major international airport or major train station . About you Required qualifications / experience: Education : MSc/PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven expertise and impact in analyzing complex data, such as real-world clinical data and multimodal omics (e.g, bulk, spatial/single-cell, proteomics) and high-throughput experimental data. Biological knowledge : Strong knowledge of molecular biology and at least one major therapeutic area (oncology, Immunology & Inflammation, neurology, …). Bias for action : Ability to operate in fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity, and driving progress toward delivery. Engineering Proficiency : Very strong programming skills in Python; ability to both ideate and conduct exploratory analyses and data visualisations to aid interpretation; and write clean, production-grade code. Strong familiarity with coding agents. AI/ML Experience : Familiarity with machine learning concepts (e.g., cross-validation, statistical tests) and frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic AI frameworks is a plus. Communication : Exceptional ability to translate scientific complexity for non-technical internal and external stakeholders. Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience in a Biotech/Pharma environment and excellent understanding of the different steps and respective needs of the typical Pharma drug discovery pipeline. Demonstrated ability to write production-level code in deployed products. #LI-MD1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information: Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn. The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @ Owkin.com . The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information; Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format. If you think that you have been a victim of fraud, Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address hiring@owkin.com contact the following authorities: [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/ [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: AI Biologist - Aging & Longevity
description: Latch builds rigorous scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows: the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. We’re seeking an AI Biologist to join our Aging & Longevity team to help accelerate the discoveries AI can make in aging biology. About the Role You will use your scientific expertise to improve the ability of AI agents to reason like expert geroscientists. You will build tasks which evaluate aging-specific analysis capabilities and scientific taste. Your judgment will set the standard AI agents are evaluated against. In this role, you will help accelerate research across the entire aging and longevity ecosystem. You will work as part of a team of scientists and software engineers building benchmarks testing capabilities ranging from basic geroscience research to therapeutic discovery and development, including: Development, application, and interpretation of biomarkers of aging, such as proteomic and epigenetic clocks Design and analysis of experiments related to the Hallmarks of Aging , such as quantification of cellular senescence, identification of stem cell exhaustion, and measurement of genomic instability Integration and analysis of diverse data modalities, such as transcriptomics, proteomics, DNA methylation, functional measurements, health records, and imaging data Use of high-throughput screening data to discover and prioritize candidate anti-aging drug targets Requirements Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in biology, bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related field Contribution to published research in aging biology or an adjacent field (cancer, epigenetics, immunology, etc.), such as a first-author paper, thesis, or independent project. Deep familiarity with AI coding tools An ability to convey your thoughts clearly and precisely; i.e., strong scientific writing skills High agency and initiative Demonstrated track record of using R or Python to analyze scientific data Deep computational or experimental experience: Computational: applying machine learning, data analysis, or statistics to -omics data; methods development; statistical genetics Experimental: hands-on wet-lab experience performing experiments and assays relevant to aging research (e.g., sequencing library prep, studies involving model organisms, senescence assays, flow cytometry, cell or organoid culture, in vivo intervention studies) Strongly Preferred Industry experience in biotech, tech, or a similar field Multiple first-author publications Familiarity with frequently used repositories of scientific data, such as: the UK Biobank, TCGA, GEO, ENCODE, etc. Compensation $140K–$180K OTE (on-target earnings), with no ceiling. Your pay is your OTE times your weekly quota attainment. Hit quota, earn your OTE; double it, earn double. Example: $150K OTE at double quota = $300K. Your first 4 weeks (ramp) are paid at full OTE while you learn our workflows. You’re paid full OTE whenever quota can’t fairly apply: when a new project is starting, the platform goes down, or we pull you onto a special project. Benefits & Employment In the US: full-time W-2 Guaranteed floor (“base salary”) set by your state, paid on the 15th and last day of every month Health, dental, vision: 100% covered for you, 50% for dependents 401(k) (no match) PTO: 15 days to start, more as you’re promoted Outside the US: contractor Paid on performance. We want our team to have stability, so we pay 60% of your monthly OTE up front as an advance, balanced against your earnings in later paychecks. US benefits don’t apply. Growth Two tracks, based on output. Individual contributor: six levels, so up to five promotions, with OTE rising at each one. Management: after your first promotion, you can move into managing a pod or keep growing on the IC track. Location & Work Authorization Location: remote or onsite at our Mission Bay office in San Francisco. Onsite is preferred: working side by side is how we share knowledge and keep our work rigorous. We have a global team, and remote teammates regularly visit the office. Work authorization: we sponsor H-1B (new and transfers), O-1, and TN, and support STEM OPT. Culture @ Latch We practice radical transparency: you’ll know how the company is doing, what’s working, and what isn’t. It’s always us against the problem, never each other. We’re opinionated but respectful of each other’s time, and we think through possible solutions before bringing a problem to anyone. We use AI constantly, so we reward original expert judgment, not AI output passed off as your own. You’ll start on the bench that fits your expertise and can move across teams as you build a track record. Outside of work: company outings most months, team off-sites, and a community that does cycling, soccer, figure skating, boxing, running, martial arts, music, books, and game nights. Interview Process Apply. If your profile matches, we’ll send you a take-home project. Take-home project (HackerRank). We review it as soon as it arrives. Technical interview with a Member of Technical Staff (pod lead). Culture interview with our C-suite. Offer. Background check, once you accept.

title: Manager of Bioinformatics (Oncology Product Development)
description:
Natera is currently seeking a Bioinformatics Manager to join the Bioinformatics team focused on Oncology Product Development. In this role, the individual will manage a team of Bioinformaticians and Data Scientists and provide technical leadership in the design, development and validation of ctDNA-based diagnostic tests. This position requires extensive cross-functional collaboration with biostatistics, molecular biology, software engineering and commercial departments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioinformatics and data science, optimally with experience in the LDT assay development space, and an established record of project and technical leadership.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical leadership for product development projects by representing the bioinformatics team in cross-functional interactions and moving products through the full development process through validation and commercial launch.
  • Lead the effort to optimize workflows, improve tools and pressure test analysis pipelines for diagnostic tests, including the detection of cancer-associated variants and the implementation of evidence-based quality control thresholds.
  • Supervise bioinformatics scientists and data scientists, managing their technical contributions, prioritizing resources, and taking responsibility for their technical and professional development.
  • Provide input on experiment design, analysis and interpretation based on expert understanding of Natera’s technology and relevant mathematical principles.
  • Work at a high level of independence and responsibilities in carrying out assignments.
  • Contribute to our intellectual property portfolio.
  • Set standards for rigorous data analysis and lead the production of high-quality documentation. 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (bioinformatics, engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, or similar).
  • Minimum of 4-8 years of post-graduate experience in a data science and/or bioinformatics role and 1-3 years of experience as technical lead in diagnostics or a related field
  • Experience moving algorithm-based products through commercialization and launch in a medical or biological application such as diagnostic testing, medical imaging, or biotechnology
  • 1-2 years of management experience leading a technical team with demonstrable evidence of leadership and team management skills.

Desirable, but not required:

  • Prior experience analyzing cancer-associated variant detection data

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience using Python or R for scientific data analysis and visualization.
  • Strong foundation in statistical modeling/machine learning, including probability theory and estimation/classification methods.
  • Experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data, preferably including algorithm development or optimization.
  • Proven ability to apply mathematical principles to solve real estimation problems and implement practical solutions.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills to independently make sound judgments and find creative solutions to moderately complex problems.
  • Experience leading technical projects, including defining and meeting project milestones, delegating tasks to more junior team members, and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$154,000—$192,500 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

title: Scientist - Patient Stratification, Biomarkers, Translational Genomics
description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. A Day in the Life At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health. This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders. For example, a Scientist may: Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies. Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology. Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials. To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others. Who You Are Essential: Solid foundations in statistics (e.g., modelling, regression), genetics and molecular biology, and statistical programming (e.g., Python or R). Experience using at least one of the following statistical genetics approaches: GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores. Preferred: Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records. Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference. Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding) Experience building and running reproducible pipelines, e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow. Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments, e.g., DNAnexus or Verily Workbench. Experience with methods development within statistical genetics. Your Package We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment. Compensation & Growth Competitive Salary : Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure competitive compensation. Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal. Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success. Wellbeing & Time Off Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end. Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance. Enhanced Leave : Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents. Work Environment & Culture Flexible Working: Hybrid Working (e.g., from our London or Oxford Office) Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you. Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate. Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs. Ready to Build the Future? If this opportunity excites you, apply now! We are dedicated to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Genomics politely requests no contact from recruitment agencies. We do not accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies nor accept the fees associated with them. title: Associate Scientist III, Cardiac Modeling
description: The Opportunity insitro is a physical AI company dedicated to unlocking causal human biology and accelerating the delivery of better medicines to patients. You will design and execute experiments, optimize differentiation workflows, develop functional and scalable functional assays to connect cellular phenotypes to disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets. Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to Senior Scientist, Cardiometabolic Disease - Translational Genetics and requires you to be onsite at our South San Francisco office 5 days per week . Prior experience in 3D/engineered heart tissue platforms or organoids is a plus Genetic Disease Modeling: Previous experience developing genetic iPSC-CM disease models — patient-derived lines, CRISPR-edited isogenic pairs — to study cardiovascular mechanisms Cardiovascular Biology: Background in cardiomyocyte biology and/or cardiovascular disease is preferred Functional Assays: Experience with functional assays relevant to cardiomyocyte biology (contractility, calcium, electrophysiology, imaging, stress responses). Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company whose mission is to accelerate progress in human health and scientific research. IN THIS POSITION, YOU WILL

• Excellent communication skills - written and verbal.

title: Sr Research Associate, Tech Transfer
description:
Senior Research Associate (Onsite in Wilsonville, OR)

Twist Bioscience's Tech Transfer team is hiring a Senior Research Associate in Wilsonville, Oregon, to help new products and process improvements, with a particular focus on supporting orders ahead of full integration and scale. This role builds on our Research Associate II position and calls for someone who is an independent, vigilant, and detail-driven scientist who can both execute hands-on production work and help optimize the processes that bridge R&D and operations. 

You will perform manual production steps for workflows that have not yet been fully automated, while partnering closely with R&D scientists and operations to vet new processes before and during their transfer into manufacturing. This person should be able to run experiments independently, communicate effectively, and optimize processes to drive CPI and NPI success, executing experiments that deliver high-quality end products for our customers. The work can vary between DNA and protein work, so the ability to learn new techniques and methodologies quickly is a real asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently design, execute, and troubleshoot experiments, escalating when plans fall outside established protocols.
  • Support the build-out and vetting of new processes ahead of launch, working closely with R&D scientists, automation engineers, operators, and LIMS developers to confirm a process is ready for production.
  • Perform manual experiments with the intention of automating them for production processing of new or in-development workflows, helping fulfill early access orders while automation is still being built out.
  • Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, and risks before they reach manufacturing, and help implement optimizations.
  • Serve as a vigilant check on process quality, catching inconsistencies or at-risk steps and raising them before they affect downstream production or customer orders.
  • Support the writing of work instructions and training materials for manufacturing operators.
  • Operate a range of automated and manual lab equipment to execute experiments and production runs.
  • Support testing & validating Twist's LIMS platforms to generate, track, and analyze data.
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize data, and communicate findings clearly across cross-functional teams.
  • Mentor and train others on new processes and best practices.
  • Maintain thorough, organized, and audit-ready experimental and production records.

Qualifications and Required Skills

  • B.S. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a closely related field, with at least 4 years of relevant industry or research experience; or an M.S. in a related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong, hands-on background in molecular biology techniques, DNA or protein purification, DNA quantification, PCR, enzymatic and or cell-based assays, including antibody characterization assays.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound scientific judgment with minimal day-to-day direction.
  • Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with R&D and operations, as well as automation engineers, LIMS developers, and R&D scientists to support building and vetting new processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly and work effectively across teams.
  • Able to prepare technical documents, including SOPs, data summaries, and technical or analytical reports.
  • Comfortable working in a LEAN manufacturing or controlled laboratory environment, including supporting manual processing ahead of automation.
  • Self-motivated and detail-oriented, with a track record of catching issues before they escalate.
  • Experience mentoring or training other lab staff.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working with lab automation.
  • Experience with SQL and/or JSON.
  • Experience using LIMS systems.
  • Experience working with antibodies.
  • Experience supporting new product or process launches, including Early Access or limited-release programs.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing lab environments.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

title: Partner 20, Social Media Lead, Frontier
description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

a16z Frontier is a venture capital fund from Andreessen Horowitz that invests in emerging technologies across AI, biology, crypto, hardware, and more. We’re drawn to the outer planets, the outliers and edge cases that don’t fit neatly into preset categories. This has been our approach for years: backing founders building a future no one else sees yet, long before it becomes mainstream. Some projects start out looking absurd or unserious — more like toys, experiments, or weekend hobbies — but go on to change lives. 

The Frontier marketing team supports portfolio companies through R&D; engineering, security, and best practices; legal and regulatory, designed to guide founders and policymakers in traditionally unregulated or tough regulatory environments; go-to-market expertise, including platform support and partnerships for emerging markets; recruiting services to scale businesses; and marketing that helps founders and others navigate the frontier. 

This is a rare opportunity at an established, prolific “direct media” operation — a model pioneered and proven by this team for over a decade at a16z — that has published influential industry reports, op-eds, builder playbooks, podcasts/ videos, newsletters, and other content distributed on various platforms. The marketing team is composed of experienced brand marketers, top communications/ PR experts, designers, and editors coming from both established media outlets and in-house content marketing operations; the social media will cover all these marketing functions, while reporting into editorial. 

The Role

The Social Media Lead is responsible for growing a16z Frontier’s social channels, including engaging key communities across different audiences in different domains. They will work closely with the Frontier marketing team to (1) adapt and distribute existing content pieces into social media posts; and (2) help create content native to social media: clips, campaigns, and more. This spans everything from social media for external pod appearances/ media interviews to investment announcements; to events and major industry conferences; to editorial content; to special projects, campaigns, and more. 

This person will also advise the broader a16z Frontier team (from investing to operations) — as well as our portfolio companies — in social media strategy and profile building. 

This is a remote role (including on West Coast time), though occasional in-office presence will be required for regular team offsites, occasional conferences/events, and based on business needs.

To join our team, you are: 

  • Always online. You’re on top of internet culture and the latest online conversations, monitor sentiment as well as tracking industry trends and shifts. You’re able to use this context to craft and tailor compelling, informative, and entertaining social media
  • Curious and constantly learning about new domains, including the latest advancements in science and technology
  • Able to both strategize and build hands-on. You’re a doer who likes taking ideas to execution and is able to operationalize them into process, pipelines, and content calendars. But you’re not just good at the tactics: You’re also someone who is able to come up with fresh ideas — whether through collaboratively brainstorming with team members, proposing your own creative formats, or staying on top of the latest social media trends so you know which experiments to run and prioritize
  • Always analyzing social media platforms. You’re data-driven and always optimizing, but also know how to trust your intuition beyond just data and think big-picture. You and we will have hypotheses around content packages — and you will (working closely with our audience development lead) know how to test them, evaluate what’s working or not, and report back so we build those learnings into our content programs
  • A creator and a producer. You’re able to directly create social content when needed — but also able to help produce it with others, including overseeing our short-form clips operation (leveraging our technical A/V and production vendors). This includes identifying, adapting, editing, and timing the right clips — as well as other creative for social — so they’re compelling, engaging, and well-received on socials
  • Able to be our voice. You would be the online brand voice for a16z Frontier. You’re able to regularly engage with relevant social media communities and different audiences — as well as identifying and engaging key influencers across various verticals/ domains

Minimum Qualifications

  • Direct, hands-on experience owning social media for a high-visibility or high-growth brand — past experience embedded in a content operation is especially welcome 
  • Excellent communicator — through text, multimedia, design, or memes
  • Proven ability to adapt style and voice across different formats, platforms, and audiences — able to be thoughtful, smart, accessible, direct… all while striking the right tone (not corporate, not cringe, not overly whimsical, not staid) 
  • Experience with X, LinkedIn, etc. required — and optionally, with crypto-native or alt social media tools and video 
  • Strong command of data — from implementing and using various analytics tools, to regularly interpreting and reporting insights
  • Ability to collaborate well cross-functionally, meet multi-threaded deadlines, more 
  • Passionate about technology, open source, and more
  • Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams

The anticipated salary range for this role is between $199,000 - $232,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.

This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Medical Copywriter to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

We’re looking for a Medical Copywriter who can bring together scientific fluency and creative instinct — someone who knows how to turn complex clinical information into clear, compelling, brand-building copy. This is not a traditional medical writer role. We’re looking for someone with healthcare advertising experience who can concept, collaborate, and write across a range of promotional and scientific materials while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and brand voice.

The Medical Copywriter is responsible for developing medically sound, strategically sharp, and emotionally resonant copy across healthcare/pharma campaigns. This person will partner closely with Creative, Strategy, Account, Project Management, Editorial, and medical teams to bring ideas to life across multiple channels and deliverables.

The ideal candidate understands how to translate science into stories, can move fluidly between promotional copy and scientific content, and has experience working in an agency environment where deadlines are fast, standards are high, and collaboration is key.

This is a great opportunity for a writer who loves the challenge of making complex science feel human, relevant, and creatively powerful. You’ll work at the intersection of medical rigor and brand storytelling, helping shape work that is strategically grounded, emotionally intelligent, and deeply impactful.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, San Francisco, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville or Carmel.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Write for healthcare/pharma advertising campaigns across HCP, patient, caregiver, and DTC audiences
  • Translate complex clinical data, mechanism of action, and product information into clear, engaging, on-brand messaging
  • Develop copy for a wide range of deliverables, including websites, digital banners, emails, sales materials, patient education, videos, social, and other omnichannel assets
  • Partner with an Art Director and broader creative team to develop integrated campaign concepts and executions
  • Ensure all copy aligns with brand strategy, marketing objectives, tone of voice, and audience needs
  • Work closely with Medical/Scientific leadership to ensure content is accurate, balanced, and compliant
  • Participate in strategic planning, internal brainstorms, and client meetings as needed
  • Present concepts internally and incorporate feedback thoughtfully and efficiently
  • Review and refine copy throughout the agency process for clarity, grammar, consistency, and accuracy
  • Collaborate with Editorial to resolve stylistic or grammatical concerns
  • Build a strong understanding of assigned brands, disease states, competitors, and the evolving market landscape
  • Proactively identify relevant medical, competitive, or regulatory updates that may impact messaging or tactical development
  • Bring a solutions-oriented mindset to projects and contribute to the overall quality of the work

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.

description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

We're hiring a scientist with deep hands-on expertise in microscopy. As part of the Deployment team at Arcadia, you'll help us build our experimental assets and operating principles. You will take our most critical, unique approaches and make them robust and scalable. You'll work side-by-side with software and instrument engineers. The data you generate will, in many cases, inform models directly as we build towards several agentic lab-in-the-loop workflows that leverage Arcadia’s novel platform capabilities.

Levels

Technical

  • Proficiency working with early alpha and beta development systems, collaborating with optical engineers to understand unique system requirements

General

Please submit a resume and fully answer all application questions addressing your interest in and qualifications for the position. The review process will involve in-person interviews and a short, practical work test. Employment offers are contingent on reference and background checks.

description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact. We are currently seeking an Account Manager with client services experience in healthcare. The position offers a great opportunity for an individual with a passion for healthcare to work with leading clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and health IT fields. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for exceptional client service and account management activities for 3-4 accounts
  • In collaboration with account associate, senior management and project management staff, drive flawless and timely project execution and high-touch client communications
  • Participates in development of clients’ marketing strategies and tactics; collaborates with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure consensus around tactics’ scope and approach
  • Support overall account development, resourcing fiscal performance and growth
  • Support day-to-day client contact in executing ad hoc requests and delivering planned activities and materials
  • Develop draft scope of works, contracts, presentations, creative briefs, PR and marketing materials and other internal/external communications
  • Ensure client feedback is gathered, understood and addressed as appropriate across deliverables and internally
  • Document status and otherwise communicate need-to-know information to all project stakeholders to ensure progression along critical path
  • Sets meetings, provides agendas and contact reports
  • Ability to run client calls or meetings independently
  • Manage account finances; must be able to track budget, raise invoices and POs

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What You Should Have:

  • Highly organized with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Has good understanding of social media vehicles and is comfortable managing and drafting communications around them
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) – particularly PowerPoint
  • Excellent business communication ability including informal/formal presentation and writing skills; this includes confident public speaking both internally and externally with clients, vendors, and affiliates
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met
  • Able to devise and articulate solutions to problems on an ongoing basis
  • Able to clearly communicate project updates, scopes and recommendations to clients
  • Ability to develop project scopes and client and vendor contracts
  • Demonstrated experience with media monitoring, research and taking on projects with limited supervision
  • BA or equivalent work experience require

Pay Range: $63,000-$72,000 
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

title: Manufacturing Associate - IgG
description:
We are looking for motivated, enthusiastic individuals to join our Twist Bioscience Operations team in Wilsonville, OR. The Manufacturing Associate, IgG Production, will produce various IgG antibody products, focusing on molecular and cellular biology, as well as running analytic techniques in the high-throughput/highly-automated lab according to established SOPs, along with working with sensitive equipment and following good manufacturing practices. Candidates must also be a team player, neat and highly organized, able to work in a cleanroom environment and foster safe work practices.

The Manufacturing Associate will perform basic reagent handling, chemistry and molecular biology workflows in a highly automated, high-throughput manner and will be responsible for the manufacture and analysis of a variety of custom DNA based intermediates and products across Twist Bioscience’s proprietary process workflow to meet the Twist production forecast and timelines. 

The ideal candidate will be driven and will do what it takes to keep manufacturing on track in a fast paced start-up environment.  The Manufacturing Associate will be responsible for the production of custom gene based products and/or various intermediates according to established SOPs and complete manufacturing batch records to contribute to the daily production schedule.  

Roles and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Manufacture high quality custom products in a high throughput MFG lab according to established SOPs.
  • Operate laboratory equipment and liquid handling robots such as Hamilton Stars, bioanalyzers, centrifuges, sealers, thermocyclers, spectrometers, Illumina Next-Gen sequencers etc.)
  • Effectively use molecular and cell biology processes and techniques, especially PCR, DNA quantitation, purification and cloning. 
  • Maintain thorough, accurate and detailed documentation of all work performed using existing document templates and software applications.
  • Update and write work instructions and documentation.
  • Work independently and in a safe manner.
  • Pay great attention to details and perform consistent work without excessive supervision.
  • Help Leads and Supervisors with troubleshooting and the handling of process deviations.
  • Package and/or organize products for shipping.
  • Work according to Good Manufacturing and ISO practices. Learn, adopt and promote lean manufacturing concepts.
  • Complete all the daily assigned tasks to keep the manufacturing schedule on track and report back to Lead and Supervisor.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Relevant experience that can indicate success in a high throughput, fast pace laboratory manufacturing environment.
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in Biology, chemistry or related field is desirable.
  • Familiarity or prior experience in a manufacturing and/or a laboratory environment is highly desirable.
  • Good written and verbal skills are critical.
  • Good computer skills (Excel, Word, Atlassian etc) and the ability to quickly learn new software applications.
  • Ability to pay great attention to details.

Working Conditions

  • The work will be performed in a very dynamic laboratory team environment.
  • It is a controlled laboratory environment.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time while performing duties.
  • Must be able to work safely with chemicals and hazardous materials.
  • Must be able to lift up to 20 lbs.
  • Must be able to work outside of regular work hours/ work a flexible shift as needed

 

Please indicate shift preferences in your application.

Possible Shifts:

1A: Sun-Tues, alt Wed, 7am-7:30pm
1B: alt Tuesday, Wed-Friday, 7am-7:30pm

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

title: Sr. Content Creator, AP Business and Personal Finance (12-Month Fixed Term)
location: San Mateo, CA / Remote (Continental US + Hawaii)
description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

OUR COMMUNITY 

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced AP or high school business and finance educator to join Khan Academy as a Sr. Content Creator, AP Business and Personal Finance (12-Month Fixed Term). Your focus will be helping us build a free, high-quality course aligned to College Board's new AP Business with Personal Finance framework.

Khan Academy's Financial Literacy course already reaches students and adult learners across the country. The AP Business with Personal Finance course goes deeper than our current foundational content, and about half of it covers business and entrepreneurship. You'll bring the subject expertise and AP classroom perspective to help us get there.

You'll work side by side with our Senior Content Creator for Financial Literacy, who will scope the course with you and guide the work. You'll be a primary creator of content for the AP course, and you won't be working alone: you'll collaborate with other members of the content team, and possibly with external reviewers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with our Senior Content Creator to map the AP Business with Personal Finance course framework against existing Khan Academy content, and shape a scope and sequence of units, lessons, and assets.
  • Design and write AP-aligned exercises, articles, and lesson video scripts across business, entrepreneurship, and personal finance topics, building on our current Financial Literacy content where it fits.
  • Write practice questions that reflect the style and rigor of AP assessments, including the misconceptions and reasoning students need to work through.
  • Review and edit content from teammates and reviewers, and help with peer review of other Financial Literacy projects as timing allows.
  • Learn and use our content management system to build and publish the course.
  • Keep work on schedule against shared milestones, and share progress clearly with the content team and our Philanthropy partners.
  • Bring your classroom perspective to our course planning, so the course works well for AP teachers and their students.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR YEAR

Over your 12-month term, you and our Senior Content Creator will publish at least four units of the AP course, giving teachers and students a strong start on the full course.

  • First 30 days: Learn our content tools and style standards, study the AP framework, and help finalize the course scope and sequence.
  • First 3 months: Publish your first lessons and exercises, with a clear plan and timeline for the rest of the year.
  • By the end of your term: Four units are complete, published, and available to the public.
  • Throughout: Content you create meets our quality bar for accuracy, rigor, and accessibility, and leaves a clear foundation for the remaining units.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • At least 3 years of classroom experience teaching high school business, entrepreneurship, marketing, economics, or personal finance, with AP experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of both business and personal finance concepts, from business planning and marketing to budgeting, credit, investing, and taxes.
  • Familiarity with College Board's AP course and exam design, and an understanding of how students prepare for AP-style questions.
  • Proven ability to create clear, rigorous learning materials such as lessons, assessments, or curriculum.
  • Strong intuition for how students learn and where they commonly get stuck.
  • Excellent writing skills and careful attention to detail.
  • Comfort working independently against deadlines, while collaborating closely with a small team.
  • Fluency with Google Docs and Sheets, and a willingness to learn new tools, some of which leverage AI for scaling.
  • A working knowledge/1-2 years experience with LLM-enabled workflows 
  • A passion for education and for helping every student take charge of their future.
  • Motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere."
  • Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of other, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience teaching or piloting AP Business with Personal Finance, or completing College Board professional development for the course.
  • Experience as a DECA, FBLA, or similar advisor, especially leading students to state or national competitions.
  • An advanced degree in business, finance, economics, or education, such as an MBA.
  • Relevant teaching experience at an undergraduate level. 
  • Professional experience in finance, business, or entrepreneurship outside the classroom.
  • Experience writing assessment items for AP, state exams, or published curriculum.
  • Experience creating digital or online learning content.

ABOUT THE TERM

  • Term: This is a full-time, salaried, fixed-term role for 12 months, expected to begin in January 2027.
  • Reports to: Director, US Content, working day to day with the Senior Content Creator for Financial Literacy.
  • Location: Remote, within the United States.
  • Renewal: Extension beyond the 12-month term depends on funding and business needs. Fellows are welcome to apply for other open roles at Khan Academy during their term.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team extremely well! We offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Ample paid time off
  • Generous parental leav
  • 401(k) with 4% matching, plus medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Affinity groups and a supportive, mission-driven team
  • The chance to put your talents toward work that reaches millions of learners

At Khan Academy we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, the well-being of our employees, and our Khan community. This belief is why we have built out a robust Total Rewards package that includes competitive base salaries, and extensive benefits and perks to support physical, mental, and financial well-being.

HOW TO APPLY

Along with your resume, please include a brief cover letter that tells us why you're interested in this role and describes your most relevant experience, using 1-2 specific examples.

The compensation band for this role is $96,800 - $108,900 USD annually for candidates based in the United States.

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only. The salary offered will depend on internal pay equity and the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and job market data. 

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:  http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.

As part of this commitment, Khan Academy will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact careers@khanacademy.org

title: Implementation Manager
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together. To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. RESPONSIBILITIES Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers. Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge. Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments. Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs. Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users.   • Test targeting lipids for the tLNP platform using an SAR-based approach to guide the next design cycle.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Are you looking to launch a high-impact career in tech sales? As an entry-level Sales Development Representative (SDR) at RTI, you will serve as the engine of our sales pipeline. You will learn the ins and outs of software architectures powering mission-critical systems across key verticals: Aerospace & Defense (A&D), Automotive, and Commercial technology.

In this role, you will partner closely with Account Managers (AMs), Business Development (BDs), Field Application Engineers (FAEs), and Marketing to identify potential customers and engage engineering end users, leaders, and decision-makers. This is an ideal role for an ambitious self-starter who is excited by technology, eager to master modern sales strategies, and motivated by career growth.

Hybrid | Denver, CO: This role requires onsite work 1–2 days per week; candidates must live within a reasonable commuting distance or be willing to relocate.

✨ What You’ll Do 

  • Outbound Prospecting (~70% Focus): Execute multi-channel outreach campaigns (phone, personalized email, LinkedIn) to target accounts across Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, and Commercial sectors to generate interest in RTI solutions.
  • Inbound Qualification (~30% Focus): Quickly follow up on marketing-generated leads (MQLs) to qualify intent, evaluate potential fit, and route high-potential opportunities to the sales team.
  • Account & Prospect Research: Conduct foundational research on target engineering organizations to identify key stakeholders, uncover potential project initiatives, and connect with messaging around specific industry pain points.
  • Discovery & Meeting Booking: Engage prospects in initial business discussions to uncover project timelines and technical challenges, scheduling discovery calls for Account Managers.
  • Continuous Technical Learning: Participate in ongoing training to build a working knowledge of RTI Connext®, embedded systems, real-time connectivity, and key industry trends in autonomous vehicles, defense systems, and commercial IoT.
  • Sales & CRM Hygiene: Maintain disciplined tracking of daily activities, outreach steps, and account notes within Salesforce and modern sales tools to ensure data accuracy.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside Account Managers and Marketing to refine messaging, align on account strategies, and optimize outreach workflows.

🎯 What We’re Looking For

  • Experience Level: 0–2 years of professional experience (entry-level candidates, recent graduates, or candidates with internship/customer-facing experience are encouraged to apply).
  • Core Aptitude: Highly motivated, resilient, and driven to launch a long-term career in enterprise technology sales.
  • Curiosity & Tech Interest: A strong interest in—or familiarity with—how software impacts physical systems (e.g., autonomous vehicles, defense platforms, healthcare robotics, or complex commercial systems).
  • Communication Skills: Clear, confident, and professional written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable making outbound phone calls and reaching out to technical buyers.
  • Coachability & Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new concepts quickly, accept constructive feedback, and continuously refine prospecting tactics.
  • Tech-Savvy: Familiarity with standard business tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, LinkedIn) and a fast learner when adopting sales enablement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Gong).

Don’t meet every single requirement? At RTI, we are dedicated to building a fair and inclusive workplace so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t perfectly align with all qualifications in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway! You may be just the right candidate for this or another one of our open roles. Learn more about our commitment to our workforce, here!

🌟 What We Offer You 

  • Flexible working schedule. 
  • Remote working + Home Office Stipend to cover the costs of working from home.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off + “Real Vacation Bonus,” an additional bonus for taking more than 1-week of uninterrupted vacation.
  • Annual bonus based on individual and company performance + other prizes and awards. 
  • We recognize employees for their achievements, offer great opportunities for career growth and development, and provide the tools they need to succeed.

💙 How is life at RTI

  • We have been certified as a Great Place to Work for seven consecutive years both in Spain and the US. In addition, we were listed as one of the Best Companies for Women to Advance. 
  • We live and work by our core values, which emphasize excellence, teamwork, and reaching your potential. Our motto is “Enjoy the journey,” above all we must enjoy what we do and have fun at work. At RTI, you will work in a positive, supportive, diverse environment with a team that truly cares about you.
  • We are defined by our “Working as One” culture and truly care about team’s interaction. That is why we plan trips for teams to get together in person, enjoy fun team-building activities and events, and feel more connected.

🌍 What We Do 

Real-Time Innovations (RTI) is the data-streaming company for intelligent distributed systems. RTI Connext® software is the critical nervous system for over 2,000 designs across Aerospace and Defense, MedTech, Automotive, and Robotics. Connext is the only real-time data streaming platform that can both control demanding physical systems and integrate them with cloud applications. RTI helps organizations develop, deploy, and scale intelligence and physical AI from edge to cloud, faster. RTI Runs a Smarter World™. Learn more at www.rti.com.

RTI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

The compensation range for this role is $70K - 80K OTE depending on experience. The salary range displayed on this job posting reflects a minimum and maximum target. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Own your part: take responsibility for a component or workstream, from design to deployment, and deliver it with limited supervision. Work with the client: understand their business problem, help turn it into clear requirements, and explain your technical choices and trade-offs to stakeholders. Own the quality: be accountable for what you ship, backed by testing, documentation and code reviews with your team. Learn and share: grow quickly alongside senior engineers, and share what you learn with the rest of the team. Why You'll Love It Solve problems that matter: work directly with clients on complex challenges where Data & AI materially improves how their business runs. Build, not just advise: you ship code that runs for real users, not slide decks. Work at the edge of Data & AI: GenAI and agents, AI engineering, modern data platforms. Work with people who raise the bar: deeply technical engineers and data scientists who care about solving hard problems and will help you grow. Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself. Who You Are 2 to 4 years of experience building software, data or AI systems, and you are hands-on: you have written production code in Python in the last 3 months. Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production. Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code. Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs. You have owned technical work end to end: a feature, a component or a pipeline you were responsible for. You learn fast and look for feedback: you want to improve your code and your craft. You enjoy working with clients and can explain technical choices clearly. Experience in consulting or another client-facing environment is a plus. Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus. How We Hire Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study. Learning activities such as ML and Engineering Knowledge Sharing Groups. Up to 10% of paid time for self-development. Opportunity to join a fast-growing service company with a start-up atmosphere. Work with an international team made of more than 15 nationalities. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events (off-site or on-line). Fun Fund to spend with the team on after-work activities. Compensation package including base salary and profit sharing based on the performance of the company Extended parental leave conditions. Why Unit8? At Unit8, we don’t just turn data into value – we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here. Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture. Meaningful Work: You drive things that matter and make others' projects easier through your work. Passion-Led Projects: We provide the environment where you can pursue your passion alongside top talent. If you are excited about the future, you belong with us.
