title: Building Engineer
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

Arc Institute operates advanced wet-lab and research facilities where uptime directly protects irreplaceable science: cell lines, samples, and instruments representing years of work. We're hiring a hands-on Facilities Building Engineer to own the reliability of our building systems and lab-critical environments. 

This is a working engineer role. You will diagnose and fix problems yourself, and you’ll know when a job calls for a specialist. You will direct our vendor and contract-support partners to get it done right, on time, and on budget. You'll also run facility projects end-to-end and serve as the calm, service-oriented point of contact for the researchers who depend on the building.

About you

  • You catch problems early, before they turn into a researcher’s bad day. You’re just as comfortable running a diagnostic yourself as you are getting a vendor on the phone to handle something that’s not yours to touch. You want to know why a system works the way it does, not just how to patch it.
  • You like being around science, even though you’re not a scientist. You get that a freezer failure here isn’t an inconvenience; it’s years of someone’s work. That weight doesn’t stress you out. It’s part of what makes the job worth doing well.
  • You don’t need a lot of ramp-up time or close supervision to take ownership. You’re comfortable being the primary engineer onsite, you set your own priorities, and you integrate with the team from day one.
  • You’re straightforward and easy to track down. You build trust through consistent follow-through.

  • Serve as the primary onsite contact for facilities service requests; deliver responsive, professional service to researchers and staff.

  • Interpret and adjust the building automation system (e.g., Alerton, Automated Logic, Johnson Controls, Siemens)

  • Support compliance with Bay Area Air Quality Management District (BAAQMD) permits for generators and boilers, and with CUPA, hazardous materials, and wastewater-discharge requirements
  • Align building operations with CDC/NIH BMBL biosafety guidance in coordination with EH&S.
  • Drive energy efficiency and monitoring across high-load systems (compute/cooling, freezer farm), identifying sustainability and cost-reduction opportunities.

title: Literacy Coach
description:
About the Team

Michigan Online School (MOS) is a K-12 tuition-free online public school in the state of Michigan. At MOS, we empower students to be their best by enabling them to learn in ways that are right for them – using innovative technology at home, at their proper level, and at their own pace.

The Literacy Coach partners with teachers, school leaders, and instructional teams to strengthen literacy instruction and improve student achievement. Through job-embedded coaching, professional learning, collaborative planning, classroom modeling, and data-informed support, the Literacy Coach helps educators implement evidence-based literacy practices aligned with Michigan academic standards and state literacy initiatives.

The Literacy Coach works collaboratively with teachers, principals, leadership teams, and data specialists to build instructional capacity, support effective literacy interventions, strengthen reading outcomes, and promote continuous school improvement. This position emphasizes a collaborative, relationship-driven approach to professional growth and instructional excellence.

Eligibility: Open to residents of Michigan

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Instructional Coaching & Teacher Support

  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with teaching staff grounded in mutual respect, teamwork, and accountability.

  • Partner with classroom teachers to implement evidence-based early literacy instructional practices through job-embedded coaching.

  • Provide individualized and small-group coaching through classroom observations, instructional modeling, co-teaching, collaborative planning, goal-setting, and reflective conversations.

  • Model effective whole-group and small-group literacy instruction for teachers and students.

  • Support teachers in developing effective classroom literacy environments and implementing research-based instructional strategies and literacy programs.

  • Coach teachers in structured literacy lesson design and the implementation of practices aligned with state standards.

title: Data Management Consultant, IDSR in Private Health Facilities
description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

In partnership with the World Health Organization, Ethiopia’s Federal Ministry of Health (FMoH), and the Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI), Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) has been implementing Strengthening IDSR in Private Health Facilities. The project supports private health facilities to prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats while maintaining essential health services through core interventions of capacity building, longitudinal mentorship, supportive supervision, monitoring of key indicators, and data use to guide tailored interventions at the facility level.

Length of Engagement: 4 months. The contracting and commencement of the assignment are contingent on confirmation and availability of funding.

Level of Effort: Equivalent to FTE

Location: Remote with travel as stated within Ethiopia

Job Structure: Independent Contractor 

  • Must have a registered business license to operate as a consultant in Ethiopia, or be willing to get one before the contract is signed.

Position Summary

The Data Management Consultant will support expansion into additional facilities and strengthen ongoing project implementation across 13 regions. The Data Management Consultant will work with the Regional Implementation Consultants and provide cross-cutting data management, quality assurance, analysis, visualization, and reporting support across all participating regions. 

The consultant will ensure that data generated through facility assessments, training, mentorship, supportive supervision, and routine project monitoring are complete, accurate, timely, appropriately managed, analyzed, visualized, and used to inform implementation and decision-making.

The Data Management Consultant will support implementation across all project regions and will work closely with the four Regional Implementation Consultants, the Principal Manager for Prevent Epidemics, and the Epidemic Ready Primary Health Care (ERPHC) Technical Advisor to achieve all deliverables. 

Core Tasks and Activities

Digital Data Collection Tools and Systems 

  • Support the set-up, review, testing, and configuration,  of ODK-based data collection tools used for mentorship, supportive supervision, and other project monitoring activities. 
  • Update facility master lists, facility codes, regional identifiers, and other reference information required for standardized data collection and reporting across project regions. 
  • Orient and provide technical support to Regional Implementation Consultants, assessors, mentors, mentees, and other relevant project participants on the appropriate use of ODK and other digital data-collection and reporting tools. 
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for data collection, submission, correction, and management throughout project implementation. 

 Data Management and Data Quality Assurance 

  • Support the development and implementation of project data-management procedures, including data cleaning, validation, organization, documentation, storage, and quality assurance. 
  • Assess data submitted from all participating regions and facilities for data completeness, timeliness, consistency, validity, duplication, and missing information. 
  • Clean, consolidate, and manage data received from all participating regions and maintain updated project datasets throughout the implementation period. 
  • Identify data-quality issues and work closely with the Regional Implementation Consultants and relevant regional teams to correct identified gaps and improve data quality. 
  • Review mentorship data submitted each month and provide timely data-quality feedback to the Regional Implementation Consultants and project team to support corrective action. 
  • Support data-quality spot checks and verification of selected facility data, as needed, to ensure that data submitted through project monitoring tools are consistent with facility records. 

Data Analysis and Visualization 

  • Analyze  baseline assessments, mentorship data, supportive supervision data, endline assessments, and other relevant project monitoring data. 
  • Develop,  and  update Power BI dashboards and other agreed data-visualization products to monitor progress across regions and facilities. 
  • Analyze and visualize key project indicators, including implementation coverage, mentorship progress, PHEM and IPC performance, facility improvements, data completeness and timeliness, and other relevant indicators. 
  • Prepare regional and overall data summaries, tables, charts, and other analytical outputs for routine project monitoring, performance review meetings, and decision-making. 
  • Support Regional Implementation Consultants and the project team in interpreting project data and identifying implementation gaps, trends, areas requiring follow-up, and opportunities for course correction. 

Project Monitoring and Reporting 

  • Provide data and analytical inputs to monthly project progress reports, Pandemic Fund reporting requirements, performance review meetings, and other project reporting needs. 
  • Support endline data consolidation and analysis, including comparison of baseline and endline performance and documentation of changes in PHEM and IPC indicators across participating facilities and regions. 

Documentation, Handover, and Sustainability 

  • Maintain organized and secure project datasets, data-collection tools, analytical files, dashboards, and relevant data-management documentation throughout the consultancy. 
  • Prepare and hand over final cleaned datasets, data dictionaries, data-collection tools, dashboards, analytical outputs, and other agreed data-management products at the end of the contract. 
  • Support additional data-management, monitoring, analysis, visualization, and reporting activities within the scope of and relevant to the project as agreed with the ERPHC Technical Advisor. 
  • Strengthen regional capacity and facilitate the handover of data management processes, including the development of region-specific plans for data management systems and data use, to ensure a smooth transition and sustained system functionality after the project close out. 

Contract Deliverables

The Data Management Consultant will be responsible for the following key deliverables: 

  • Project data-management system established and maintained, including reviewed and tested ODK data-collection tools, facility master lists/codes, data organization structures, and data-quality procedures. 
  • Relevant project staff and implementation teams supported on digital data collection, including orientation and technical support on ODK, data submission, correction, and data-quality requirements. 
  • Monthly mentorship and project-monitoring data consolidated and quality-assured, including  monitoring of data completeness, timeliness, validity, consistency, duplication, and missing information. 
  • Power BI dashboard maintained and updated to visualize key project indicators and implementation progress across participating regions and facilities. 
  • Monthly data analysis and visualization completed, with appropriate summary tables, charts, dashboards, and analytical inputs provided for project monitoring, performance review meetings, and monthly reporting. 
  • Data-quality issues identified, documented, and communicated to Regional Implementation Consultants and the project team, with appropriate follow-up and correction supported. 
  • Data and analytical inputs provided for final project reporting, including regional and overall performance summaries, trends, achievements, gaps, and relevant visualizations. 
  • Final project data package completed and handed over, including final cleaned datasets, data dictionary, ODK forms, dashboard files, analysis outputs, and relevant data-management documentation. 

Contract Management

The Consultant will submit deliverables to the ERPHC Technical Advisor for review and acceptance. The Principal Manager for Prevent Epidemics will manage the contract and approve invoices. 

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in public health, epidemiology, biostatistics, health informatics, monitoring and evaluation, data science, health information systems, or a related field. 
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in public health data management, monitoring and evaluation, epidemiology, health information systems, disease surveillance, or related areas. 
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in managing, cleaning, validating, analyzing, and visualizing public health or health-program data. 
  • Hands-on experience with ODK/ODK Central or comparable electronic data-collection platforms, including form testing, data management, export, cleaning, and troubleshooting. 
  • Experience with Power BI dashboards, including development or maintenance of dashboards and visualization of program-monitoring indicators. 
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using statistical or analytical software such as R, Stata, SPSS, Python, or other comparable tools. 
  • Experience conducting and documenting data-quality assurance, including assessment of data completeness, timeliness, validity, consistency, and accuracy. 
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and translate data into clear dashboards, tables, charts, summaries, and other products that can support programmatic decision-making. 
  • Strong organizational and data-management skills, with excellent communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with technical and program teams. 
  • Ability to manage and consolidate data from multiple regions and implementation teams while maintaining standardized data-management and quality-assurance procedures. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications. 
  • Fluent in English and Amharic. 
  • Willingness and ability to travel within Ethiopia as needed to provide data-management support, participate in relevant project activities, and conduct data-quality verification and supportive supervision. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience working with DHIS2, particularly health surveillance, PHEM, or related health-program data, is an advantage. 
  • Knowledge and understanding of Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR), Public Health Emergency Management (PHEM), Infection Prevention and Control (IPC), or related public health programs is an advantage. 
  • Experience working closely with EPHI and regional counterparts, including Regional Health Bureaus (RHBs) and/or Regional Public Health Institutes (RPHIs), is an advantage. 

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit their CV and a cover letter detailing their suitability for the role.

We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

The Role

Profluent is seeking a motivated, rigorous, and collaborative scientist to establish and lead a centralized gene editor screening function. High-quality experimental data is a core input to our protein design models, and this role will own the screening operations that produce it.

This role centers on building and running a screening core responsible for assay standardization, data quality, and team development. At first, you will support campaigns that generate training and evaluation data for our protein design models, and the scope may grow to cover more programs. You will design, run, and troubleshoot mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats. You will set the technical standards that make our data reproducible and trustworthy. You will also build and mentor a team of Research Associates, and coordinate closely with Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology to keep the screening pipeline running smoothly from start to finish.

As a leader of the team, you will balance hands-on scientific execution with people management and process development. You will identify, prioritize, and drive infrastructure projects that improve throughput, consistency, and assay sensitivity. You will also work with leadership to shape the long-term scope of the core.

We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who share our commitment to revolutionizing biology, driving meaningful innovation, and making a lasting impact on global healthcare.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven protein design while collaborating with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team of experts in machine learning, protein engineering, cell biology, and gene editing.

 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a team of 2–4 Research Associates, including hiring, training, performance management, and career development
  • Train and mentor staff on aseptic technique, assay execution, and documentation standards
  • Foster a supportive team culture that prioritizes growth, engagement, and well-being

Execution

  • Prioritize, schedule, and resource cross-functional experiments in coordination with Automation and Bioinformatics
  • Design, execute, troubleshoot, and analyze mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats
  • Onboard new assays and extend existing assays to new enzyme classes
  • Maintain sample chain of custody from plate mapping through automation, sample preparation, and sequencing submission, partnering with Bioinformatics on data schema and capture
  • Communicate technical results clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences
  • Deliver QC'd, analysis-ready datasets with documented QC flags to ML

Process Development

  • Define and enforce technical standards, and write and maintain SOPs
  • Qualify new assays and define acceptance criteria based on reproducibility data
  • Maintain cell line quality and inventory for screening assays, in coordination with teams that manage cell banks
  • Characterize assay sensitivity, including the minimum detectable difference in activity at standard replicate counts
  • Identify, prioritize, and plan infrastructure projects that continually improve assays and processes
  • Coordinate process development across Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology
  • Evaluate the costs and benefits of centralizing high-throughput workflows in partnership with other teams
  • Work with leadership to assess and refine the scope of core functions

 

Qualifications

  • PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related field and 2+ years of relevant industry experience, or MS in a related field and 10+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Hands-on experience with bacterial and mammalian cell culture, genome editing, and NGS-based assays
  • Experience with high-throughput experimentation and analysis of large datasets
  • Experience with LIMS or ELN systems for sample and experiment tracking
  • Demonstrated ability to establish technical standards and drive consistent execution across operators


Preferences

  • Experience working in or building a core facility or centralized service function
  • Track record of building or improving high-throughput processes
  • Experience leading infrastructure or process improvement projects
  • Experience with liquid handling automation and tech transfer

title: Molecular & Cell Biologist
description:
About the team

We use evolution to structure, explore, and engineer biology. Our Deployment team applies Arcadia’s novel, validated platform and instrument technologies to bench research. The primary focus of the team is to quickly execute on technical projects for commercial partners, develop well-designed experimental case studies for our platform and products, and develop autonomous AI/wetlab iteration circuits for critical predictions and technologies.

The role

We're hiring a scientist with deep hands-on expertise in molecular and cell biology. As part of the Deployment team at Arcadia, you'll help us build our experimental assets and operating principles. You will take our most critical, unique approaches and make them robust and scalable. You'll work side-by-side with software and instrument engineers. The data you generate will, in many cases, inform models directly as we build towards several agentic lab-in-the-loop workflows that leverage Arcadia’s novel platform capabilities.

Levels

  • Scientist: PhD or PhD-level experience, plus at least 2 years full-time experience in industry. Should be capable of owning the experimental design and execution for projects.

Requirements

Technical

  • Hands-on expertise in molecular cloning and DNA assembly (e.g., Golden Gate or Gibson assembly), including design and sequence verification of constructs and libraries
  • Genetic engineering experience in at least one relevant host
  • Experience building variant or perturbation libraries and running pooled or arrayed screens (e.g., mutagenesis, CRISPR, or directed evolution)
  • Experience with high-dimensional phenotypic readouts

General

  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate and test new use cases and considerations for scientific tools and assays
  • Curiosity about how evolution and organismal diversity can inform experimental design and interpretation
  • Effective working in a tight team operating fast-paced cycles typical of early-stage start-ups
  • Willingness to adjust methods and priorities as new data comes in
  • A track record of independently designing, running, and interpreting experiments end to end, with clear outputs
  • Sound experimental design, including appropriate controls, replication, and solicitation of feedback
  • Comfort analyzing and visualizing data with agentic tools and understanding of Python and R
  • Familiarity with agentic workflows and coding practices
  • Disciplined data and documentation habits: consistent formats, complete metadata, and protocols that a colleague or an automated system can run as written
  • Clear written and verbal communication with collaborators outside your area of expertise

Nice to have

  • People or project management experience
  • Experience working with high-dimensional data, including advising on how data should be structured, upholding statistical rigor, and guiding collaborators on what the results can and can’t support
  • Experience working with non-model organisms or comparative approaches across species

Compensation

Successful applicants can expect to be compensated between $135,000 - 200,000 with benefits and a competitive equity offering, depending on experience level. 

Application Process 

Please submit a resume and fully answer all application questions addressing your interest in and qualifications for the position. The review process will involve in-person interviews and a short, practical work test. Employment offers are contingent on reference and background checks. 

Arcadia is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds and communities. We provide competitive compensation and practical benefits to keep you happy and healthy so that you can do your best work.

title: Research Associate 2
description:
LOCATION: On-Site in Boulder, CO (Foresight Dx business unit, a Natera company)

 

ABOUT OUR COMPANY:

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer. 

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us. 

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Every liquid biopsy result starts at the bench, and this role puts you right there. As part of our Boulder R&D team, you’ll work hands-on with scientists developing ultrasensitive, cell-free DNA technology designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment for patients with cancer. You’ll run experiments across the NGS workflow, from gDNA isolation and library prep to hybrid capture and sequencing, using automated liquid handlers and instruments like the TapeStation and Qubit. Along the way, you’ll learn to troubleshoot, keep instruments running smoothly, and understand why an experiment behaves the way it does, not just how to run it.

You won’t work in a silo. You’ll partner daily with Associates and Scientists, summarize and present your data to the team, and write SOPs that shape how we work. Your notebooks, results, and attention to detail will be trusted and relied on by the people around you. Foresight’s Stanford-born science now has the backing of Natera, a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, so you’ll get the agility of a mission-driven startup with the resources and reach of an established company. If you have a few years of molecular biology experience and want to build deep expertise in one of the most exciting areas of modern diagnostics, in a collaborative, high-accountability culture where quality and continuous improvement are part of everyday work, we’d love to meet you.

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

You will work primarily with R&D assisting Associates/Scientists in various lab duties. Responsibilities will include:

  • Independently execute simple experiments and perform basic troubleshooting 
  • Produce competent, reproducible results to a high technical standard
  • Maintain accurate and well-organized laboratory records, worksheets and notebooks
  • Summarize data in spreadsheets, graphs and presentations
  • Write standard operating procedures (SOP) and other lab-related documents as needed
  • Maintain equipment and instruments in good operating condition, recognize any malfunctions and troubleshoot as needed
  • Utilize molecular biology techniques in performing laboratory tests. This role will have occasional access to PHI both in paper and electronic form and have occasional access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.
  • Adhere to environmental, health and safety (EHS) guidelines and good laboratory practices (GLP)
  • Perform other tasks as specified by the manager/director

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS/BA in a biological science or equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years Molecular Biology laboratory experience required

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • gDNA isolation from biological samples (preferred).
  • Experience with library preparation for next generation sequencing and sequencing platforms 
  • Experience with hybrid capture technologies
  • Experience with laboratory automated liquid handler platforms
  • Sample analysis/QC on the Agilent Tapestation, Nanodrop, Qubit, electrophoresis
  • Must have proven interpersonal, communication, computer, and technical skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills required.
  • Microsoft Excel experience required

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays
  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range 

$74,800.00 - $89,000.00

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

Equipment Engineer (Onsite in Wilsonville, OR)

Programmable DNA, the software of life, is finally here! Twist Bioscience is developing a disruptive synthetic DNA technology that will change the world, enabling widespread health and sustainability. Synthetic biologists will use our products to engineer how organisms produce cures to diseases, make everyday chemicals by using the atmosphere as the carbon source, enable plants to make their own fertilizers, and to create in-vivo diagnostics that alert us when we are sick, and many more applications.

The primary function of the Equipment Engineer is to maintain all production instruments in a fast-paced DNA synthesis environment. The Equipment Engineer will test production instruments for daily, weekly, and monthly quality metrics, maintain documentation of such tests, troubleshoot, perform general, routine, and preventative maintenance on all equipment, and schedule service calls as needed. The ideal candidate would be self-motivated and perform other production duties as required.

  • Assume ownership of performing installation qualification, operational qualification, and performance qualification on new equipment and existing equipment.
  • Assume ownership of performing routine preventative maintenance and calibration of equipment in accordance with equipment manufacturer specifications.

  • Follow regulatory and ISO 13485 requirements.

  • Assume ownership of training programs in respect to lab instrumentation.
  • Schedule and coordinate onsite vendor/field service engineer visits.
  • Support on-call engineer schedule rotation.

  • BS in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical/Electronics) or Biological Science field or related technical discipline.
  • Experience with NGS Sequencers & Fluorescence readers & HPLC.
  • Experience with automated liquid handlers a plus (e.g. Hamilton STAR, Labcyte ECHO).
  • Experience with laboratory analytical instruments.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical systems and instrumentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new equipment and processes.
  • Minimum of 2+ years equipment/instrumentation experience needed.

Frequent standing, walking, bending, and lifting throughout the shift.

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. title: Scientist I, Synthetic Biology
description:
The Role: 

Generate’s Prototyping Lab builds the experimental systems that let us measure protein function at unprecedented scale. By combining synthetic biology, large DNA libraries, high-throughput assays, and machine learning, the team creates workflows that turn complex biological questions into rich, usable datasets. 

We’re looking for two Scientists with a strong record in experimental synthetic biology to develop pooled screens capable of testing hundreds of thousands of protein variants in parallel to identify protein binders and modulators. You’ll shape these experiments via DNA library design, pooled in vitro protein display, and NGS-based enrichment analysis. For one of the two roles, we are looking for a Scientist who additionally has experience in mammalian cell engineering and membrane protein studies. Experience in computational modeling or statistical analysis would help you connect experimental design to the quality and usefulness of the resulting data. 

You’ll work closely with Protein Sciences and Machine Learning teams to build screening approaches that deliver clear, quantitative insight into protein function. The role offers substantial scope to originate and advance new technologies, with close collaboration across a well-resourced biotech team.

Here's how you will contribute:

  • Build pooled screening workflows to achieve scalable protein binding and functional readouts, from assay setup through data interpretation.
  • Collaboratively establish reliable assay conditions, quantitative measures, and handoff plans that enable project teams to maximize platform utility.
  • Identify opportunities to test unconventional hypotheses, applying the strongest concepts for drug program acceleration and supporting IP filings.  
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations, and present them in presentations and in writing to colleagues across disciplines.
  • Use quantitative reasoning, modeling, and critical literature review to inform experimental choices. 

The Ideal Candidate will have:

  • PhD in synthetic or systems biology, bioengineering or a related field with 0-1 year of experience; alternatively, a bachelor’s or master’s degree with at least 6 years of highly relevant experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing and running pooled binding screens, ideally using both purified proteins and cell-based assays.
  • For one of the roles, we are seeking strong cell-culture skills, including experience engineering cell lines for screening applications using methods such as CRISPR, lentiviral transduction, or transposon-based integration; experience working with membrane proteins is also highly preferred.  
  • Experience designing and building pooled DNA libraries, and using next-generation sequencing to track enrichment in selection campaigns.
  • Familiarity with recombinant protein production, purification, and/or binding assays is an advantage.
  • Ability to interpret complex screening data and write scripts in Python or a similar language; familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or other LLM-based platforms.
  • Applies quantitative reasoning and sound experimental judgment to assess data quality, troubleshoot assays, and guide next steps.
  • Takes ownership of applied biology projects from initial concept through execution, analysis, and delivery.
  • Brings intellectual curiosity to new technical challenges, shares expertise readily, and helps colleagues grow through collaboration and mentorship.
  • High level of cross-functional autonomy and self-motivation. 

Who will love this job: 

  • Biologists who integrate computational insight with experimentation to tackle complex problems.
  • Experimentalists who enjoy making difficult targets, including membrane proteins, tractable for pooled binding screens.
  • Platform builders who value assay robustness, data quality, and interpretable results alongside throughput.

About Generate Biomedicines

We are a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein-based medicines.

Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. By unifying computational design and clinical development within a single operating model, we translate this approach into clinical-stage programs and are leading a shift from traditional drug discovery toward systematic drug generation.

title: Product Manager, Platform
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW AI is only as good as the data underneath it. Schemas is the configuration layer where customers model their scientific data and processes. It's the customer-defined data model that makes Benchling different from a point solution, and the contract every other system (internal apps, integrations, AI agents) relies on when reading or writing to Benchling. Get it right, and AI inherits a solid foundation; get it wrong, every layer above inherits the problem. As Schemas PM, you own the primitives (schema types, computed fields, fieldsets, constraints, static properties, data versioning) that every other team at Benchling builds on top of. This is one of the highest-leverage, most technically interesting roles on the platform team, and one we're investing in now as AI features across Benchling increasingly depend on the quality of the underlying data model. RESPONSIBILITIES Set product direction for Schemas and ship toward it incrementally, balancing fast prototyping with the platform stability admins and developers depend on. Relentlessly track how customers use Schemas — where it delights, where it fails — and build sharp personas and job-to-be-done context for each user type (admins, scientists, computational teams, internal and external developers). Bring customer "why," not just feature requests, back to Engineering and Design; partner with them closely to ship new capabilities. Champion structured, well-modeled data as the foundation for AI value across Benchling, anticipating what schema consumers will need next. Partner with Customer Experience, Field, Sales, and Marketing to get customer signal into the roadmap early. Partner closely with other Platform and Apps PMs — schemas underpin nearly every other platform surface, so alignment on sequencing and shared abstractions matters as much as your own roadmap. QUALIFICATIONS Energized by platform work and systems thinking; comfortable building the right abstraction ahead of need. Has designed, owned, or significantly evolved a data-modeling, schema, or configuration system used by external developers or technical admins — not just consumed one as a feature. Becomes the go-to person for customers, field, and engineers — not a router to engineering. Deep, demonstrated discovery practice: has built personas and JTBD frameworks from scratch, not just used ones handed to them. Track record balancing long-term vision with incremental shipping. Strong communicator across technical and executive audiences; B2B SaaS or developer-platform background preferred. Genuine curiosity about the science behind the data. You don't need a science background, but you should want one by the end of your first quarter here. POSITION SUMMARY:


Natera is currently seeking a licensed Medical Laboratory Scientist to analyze specimens and maintains equipment in good operating condition.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:


• Verify the proper specimen being analyzed and perform tests that need to be completed
• Proficient at analyzing clinical laboratory specimens following the standard methods and procedures in an efficient manner with little to no errors
• Responsible for maintaining updated understanding and knowledge of methods performed in the lab
• Provides general oversight of personnel and the daily operations in the lab.
• Meet expected performance metrics within role as applicable.
• Follows GLP (good laboratory practice): maintain clean and organized workspace
• Completes training and other deadlines on time.
• Provide guidance for new Clinical Laboratory Operator and/or Medical Laboratory Scientists.
• Train on specialized instructions for instruments/protocols (super users)
• Recognizes and escalates equipment malfunctions; troubleshoots common analytical and processing errors according to the laboratory’s standard operating procedure
• Recognizes, documents, and escalates protocol deviations in lab to lead/supervisor
• Assists with documentation for nonconformance reports.
• Participates in the updating of departmental standard operating procedures and database to accurately reflect the current practices.
• Conducts independent continuous improvement projects
• Ensures compliance with all regulatory agency requirements through proper documentation (example maintenance logs, bench worksheet)
• Performs quality control procedures to ensure accuracy of clinical data (if applicable)
• Maintains equipment and instruments in good operating condition (such as calibration and expiration date)
• Maintain inventory of material, supplies and equipment in the laboratory for performance of duties.
• Communicates with team and other departments on various platforms (including via e-mail)
• Provides feedback on day-to-day schedule and tasks to lead/supervisor; offers suggestions/ideas for improvement
• Assists teammates in completing daily tasks and facilitate workflow as needed
• Conducts himself/herself in a professional manner; acts as a role model/mentor to others
• Adheres to Departmental Expectations
• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job
• Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.
• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS/BA degree in Medical Technology, Biological Sciences, or a related field
  • Current MT/MLS/CLS/MB certification preferable from ASCP, AMT, or AAB 


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:


• Excellent interpersonal, communication, computer, troubleshooting, and pipetting skills.
• Experience in Molecular Biology preferred.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Word processing and data management skills.
• Ability to work well in a group
• Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:


• Duties typically performed in BSL-1 to 2 laboratories with potentially hazardous material
• Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary
• Duties may require working weekends and overtime
• Must be able to lift boxes or supplies up to 35lbs
• Duties require wearing safety goggles, gloves, and laboratory coat.
• Duties require exposure to cold air due to frequent accessing of refrigeration and/or freezer units.

 

Must be able to discern color visually [or be able to evaluate cellular morphology when applicable] and pass applicable screening assessment

description:

Consulting is changing, and Veeva Business Consulting is not like other firms. Launched in 2019, we’ve grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep industry knowledge and unique insights to accelerate drug development and commercialization for our customers.
 
We are growing aggressively and seeking great people to help Life Sciences work in a more efficient and connected way, shaping the future of the industry with the world’s leading AI applications, agents, and data at their back.
 
The Role
We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of consultants through our Business Consultant Development Program (BCDP).
 
We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment to learn quickly and deliver value early. You will collaborate with experienced team members on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions.
 
In our structured 18 month program, we equip you with the resources to develop the core consulting skills, deep domain expertise, and leadership foundation for long-term career success at Veeva.
 
BCDP spans five core practice areas: Analytics, Commercial, Content, R&D, and Quality. As an Associate Consultant you will align to one of those practices, allowing you to build targeted industry expertise. You will be asked to choose your preferred practice in the application process.
 
You can learn more about our practices and the work we do here.
 
The anticipated start date is September 2027.

End-to-End Product Development: Demonstrated track record of conducting complex technical products from initial specification through R&D to final delivery and industrialization. Technical & Systems Engineering Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering (Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, Robotics, or Computer Science) or a related technical field, paired with deep knowledge of system engineering, unmanned aerial systems, and autonomous payloads. Customer & Mission-Oriented: Ability to translate complex ISR and strike mission requirements into concrete, scalable product features and configurations. Extreme Ownership: High level of accountability and autonomy, with the drive to take full responsibility for product definition, roadmap execution, and delivery outcomes. Collaborative Leadership & Active Listening: Strong communication and listening skills to build trust with R&D engineers, bridge technical and business stakeholders, and guide cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority. title: Assistant Video Editor
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting
  • Familiarity with Frame.io or similar review/delivery tools

 

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range
$70,000—$80,000 USD

OUR DEI COMMITMENT

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.

WHAT COMES NEXT

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Analytics Engineer role serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas. 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Avalere Healthについて
私たちは、「すべての患者さんに可能性を届ける」という共通の目的のもとで働いています。Avalere Healthは、すべての患者さんが必要な治療、支援、ケアを等しく受けられることを目指しています。Advisory、Medical、Marketingの各チームがそれぞれの専門性を生かして連携し、ヘルスケアが障壁とならず、誰一人取り残されない未来を築いています。

私たちは柔軟な働き方を大切にしています。各グローバルチームは、チームやクライアントのニーズに応じて、オフィス勤務または在宅勤務を選択できます。ロンドン、マンチェスター、ワシントンD.C.、ニューヨークの主要拠点に加え、世界各地のオフィスが、必要な時にチームが集まるコラボレーション拠点となっています。在宅勤務の社員にも、交流の機会や必要なリソースを提供しています。
インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。

入社後は、クライアント業務を通じて、アカウントマネジメントの基礎を実践的に身につけていただきます。周囲の支援を受けながら担当範囲を広げ、将来的にはクライアントとのやり取りや、より複雑な案件進行にも関わっていただくことを期待しています。

Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company whose mission is to accelerate progress in human health and scientific research. You will be expected to create and execute a sales strategy across academic, biotech, and pharmaceutical accounts while working closely with Field Application Scientists and other Parse team members. Candidates should have strong technical skills, sales skills, the ability to develop and manage customer relationships, and a drive to overachieve. Gaining a deep understanding of the single cell market and Parse’s products will be critical to success.

You will ideally be based in Canada (mid to eastern), covering all of Canada. All types of accounts will be covered (e.g. Academic, Pharma, Biotech, etc.).

  • Generate and manage both high volume and large complex sales

FOR THIS POSITION, WE LOOK FOR

title: PLOS One Public Health and Epidemiology Associate Editor- 12 Month FTC
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA. 

This is a 12 month FTC

In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America.

 

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all. The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals.  This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries.
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld.
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments.
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio.
  • Handle publication ethics queries.
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community.
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry.
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy.
  • Able to set priorities and work independently.

Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject area required. A PHD, MD or similiar level is preferred. 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is $67,000 to $73,000. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below. 

BENEFITS: 

 

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

 

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

 

 

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Finance Data Scientist
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. Strong stakeholder management with Finance leadership, and the ability to push back on ambiguous asks. Bonus Experience preparing finance data for audit, SOX or IPO readiness. Experience with pricing / packaging experimentation or revenue forecasting at a subscription or usage-based business. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse (BigQuery), partnering directly with analytics engineers. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Lead Finance Data Scientist role as the central Data team scales. Expand scope into broader strategic finance or RevOps analytics. Path into a Head of FP&A Analytics or data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. title: Enterprise Account Manager
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY . The Role We're looking for a dedicated Account Manager to own and accelerate expansion across our existing customer base . This is a high-impact, commercial role for someone who thrives on closing six- to seven-figure deals with enterprise teams. We've grown fast without dedicated expansion resources, but the opportunity is massive. Our team has identified millions of dollars in qualified pipeline, and we need a closer who can convert it. You'll own a book of business worth $2M+ ARR across high-growth mid-market and enterprise companies (~400-8,000 employees), managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through close. You'll be measured on Net Revenue Retention and your ability to execute consultative, value-based selling at scale. Important to know: Hours: This is an exciting but intense job. Kernel is growing extremely fast and hours can often be long. Many of our customers are on the West Coast, and meetings can be held late in the evening. Working location: Minimum 4 days a week in the London office (Borough). Most people do 5. What You’ll Be Doing Own and execute complex expansion and renewal cycles across a $2M+ book of mid-market and enterprise accounts, managing deals from six- to seven figures with technical, multi-stakeholder buying groups. Drive Net Revenue Retention by proactively identifying expansion opportunities, negotiating renewals, and preventing churn across your portfolio. You'll be commercially accountable for growing the revenue in your book. Execute consultative, value-based selling by deeply understanding each customer's RevOps challenges, articulating clear ROI, and positioning Kernel as mission-critical infrastructure for their CRM data strategy. Own the full customer relationship alongside Implementation/Solutions Engineers, proactively sourcing expansion opportunities through account mapping, strategic outreach, and deep engagement with your accounts to identify growth potential. Build and refine our Account Management playbook as a key member of our growing Account Management team, helping establish repeatable processes for expansion motions, renewal cadences, and cross-functional collaboration that will scale with the team as we grow Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership to shape our expansion strategy, feed critical customer insights into the product roadmap, and help define our enterprise selling motion. Navigate complex contracts, security reviews, and legal discussions independently, moving deals forward without constant support from leadership or legal. More specifically, you will be: Speaking the language of RevOps professionals, discussing CRM hierarchies, data hygiene, territory planning, and the technical challenges of managing company data at scale. Becoming the best person in the company at explaining and pitching the product, translating technical capabilities into clear business value for VP-level stakeholders. Running data-driven account reviews and strategic planning sessions to prioritize where to invest your time for maximum revenue impact. What You Bring Proven track record of expansion and renewal excellence: 4-7 years of B2B SaaS sales or account management experience, with at least 2 years consistently closing $100k+ deals per year and managing a book of business worth $2M+ ARR. Demonstrable commercial performance: You have a track record of consistently overachieving on Net Revenue Retention or expansion targets (130%+ NRR is the bar), with specific examples of closing significant expansions from existing customers. You're commercially driven and performance-oriented, motivated by hitting and exceeding revenue targets, and you understand the levers that drive expansion and renewal. Enterprise sales expertise: Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with technical buyers. You know how to manage 6-12 month sales cycles, build consensus across buying committees, and close six-figure deals. Consultative selling and communication skills: You can execute value-based, solutions-oriented selling, asking great questions to uncover true business pain and positioning product capabilities as strategic solutions rather than features. You have excellent verbal and written communication skills - you articulate complex ideas crisply, write compelling proposals and business cases, and present confidently to senior stakeholders. Technical fluency: Comfortable discussing technical concepts with RevOps and data teams. You can translate complex requirements into product demonstrations and articulate technical value to non-technical executives. Entrepreneurial mindset: You

title: Staff Data Engineer
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description: We want to make the best decisions possible for our products and to do that, we need to make data-driven decisions. To achieve this goal, we are looking for a talented Data Engineer - you! - to join the Data & ML Platform team. Together, we will make Sonar’s products the undisputed world-leading code remediation solution! What you will do You will design and develop the data platform to support the functional domains in handling their data and help them in their journey to data ownership. This means: Design and implement data storage, transformation, and load capabilities of our pipelines. Continuously enhance the data platform. Propose, implement and manage data handling services according to stakeholders needs (Product Managers, Marketing, Sales, engineering teams, ...) Establish top-class end-to-end pipelines including data cleaning and modelling. Develop and deploy connectors to data sources of interest. Maintain evergreen data flow documentation across systems. Collaborate on Data Governance with other stakeholders/domains. Work with the security function to ensure we adhere to expected security standards. Collaborate with the incident manager to bring your expertise when asked and own implementation of recommendations from post-mortems. Experience and qualifications You have solid software engineering experience, focusing on developing data engineering pipelines and storage in the cloud. You have been exposed to big data architecture essentials, streaming, ETL batches, data store administration, … You see yourself as a developer working on data. You are motivated by both technical and functional aspects of services. You are a friendly, enthusiastic, and organized team player. You actively share your knowledge and give and receive feedback to improve the team and yourself. Strong experience building end-to-end ETLT, ETL, or ELT pipelines with batch or streaming technologies in Python. Experience working with Databricks as a Platform or building data pipelines with PySpark is a plus. description: L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! Pourquoi on recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer ? Nos clients ont des systèmes legacy critiques, parfois vieux de 20 ans. Ils veulent les moderniser vite, sans casser ce qui marche. Pour y arriver, un bon outil IA ne suffit pas : il faut quelqu'un sur le terrain, au plus près des équipes du client, qui fait le lien entre leur réalité métier et nos agents et workflows IA. Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production. Ton équipe : Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients. Tu travailles avec un AI Architect, un Tech Lead, des Software Engineers et un Product Manager, et tu t'appuies sur une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes.
